hard_constraints: Use Star Wars Legends / Expanded Universe continuity; treat Disney-only continuity as invalid
Preserve post-Fate of the Jedi setting in 47 ABY: Jedi Order under Grand Master Luke Skywalker from Coruscant Temple
Force described through experiential and mystical language per force_mechanics; render body-experience before diagnostic vocabulary like 'Weave'
No anachronistic terms: use datapad, blaster, comlink; avoid DNA, radio, laptop, etc. per anachronistic_terms
Style: Capitalize 'Human'; decapitalize 'galaxy'; 'Jedi' singular and plural; 'Darth' capitalized before name
No meta-references: no ABY/BBY, no 'Legends'/'Canon', no Wookieepedia taxonomy
Ben Skywalker POV: single close-third; use his sensory vocabulary for Force (handrail gone, footing missing)
canon_risks: Unnamed 'young Knight' descriptions must align with referenced_characters: Master Ava Renn (disoriented), Knight Tell Maran (underconfident), Knight Drevin Los (unsettled senior); avoid inventing new modern Jedi
Outpost as small Outer Rim installation near Veranthos plausible but unconfirmed in Legends; ensure no conflict with post-Fate Jedi deployments
Meditation failure as Weave thinning effect must match Legends Force wounds (e.g., Malachor V echo) without proving new ontology
legends_continuity_notes: Post-Fate of the Jedi (47 ABY): Jedi Order reformed under Luke; outposts exist for training/surveys; Ben Skywalker ~21, established Knight after Abeloth crisis
Force wounds (Nathema, Malachor V) cause unreliable sense, emotional bleed; thin_places_moderate/high: parallax error, gaps, emotional leaks per force_mechanics
YT-series freighter Steady Returns: standard Legends tech; landing pad at outpost routine
Jedi training: lightsaber katas, meditation drills standard; disruption shows wound pressure without possession

Characters: Ben (POV), Desh, Sera, Torin, Kael; outpost Knights: Ava Renn (failing meditation), Tell Maran (stress-like reports), Drevin Los (shaken senior)
Force effects: thin_places_moderate (gaps in Force, blurred light/dark, emotional leaks); non-diagnostic: 'Force there but no shape' per Knight dialogue
Torin: Genuine tenderness + calculation; warmth preserved (e.g., commander's hand); no manipulative read
Ben arc: lie_challenged; recognizes Battlefield Node echo but no theorizing; empathetic horror to helplessness
Sensory: Too-wide eyes, too-still hands; Force unreliable (pieces, no direction); no 'Weave' naming yet
Beats: Steady Returns lands; Knight greets abnormally; abandoned drills; Knight describes lost meditation; Torin kneels (tender gesture, cold eyes)
